title: helichrysum barrelieri
intro: Helichrysum barrelieri, commonly known as False Everlasting or Barrelier's Everlasting, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family that is native to the Mediterranean region. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum barrelieri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents work together to provide a range of benefits, including pain relief, improved digestion, and enhanced immune function.
